continue: Recovery markers are all green and in full agreement: Garmin readiness 92 ('well rested and recovered'), Oura readiness 90 ('Optimal'), HRV at a 3-week high of 56ms, resting HR down to 48-49. Solid footing to keep rebuilding on.
